messages:
reena: quick ask 00 product wants the canary cost card to break out token spend vs cache impact. totals are confusing PMs. screenshot: https://our.internal/snap2.png :eyes:
kyle: totally. If we show "tokens_billed" and "cache_saved_tokens" per-variant + a normalized net_delta_per_1k_invokes that would solve a lot of noise across traffic sizes.
sid: implementation suggestion: emit a single compact snapshot at snapshot-time (one row per route+variant). POST /internal/v1/snapshots accepts minimal rows: route, variant, invocations, tokens_billed, cache_saved_tokens, token_cost_cents, baseline_snapshot_id, reasons[], approx:boolean. No full timeseries re-ingest.
morgan: UX: show paired bars (red = billed spend, green = cache savings as negative). add toggle: per-invocation vs per-token, and a per-1k normalized delta. tooltip with cents + token counts. CSV export plz.
reena: product also asked for a short "why" pill: top_reason enum (model_swap | token_shift | prompt_change) + confidence. Keep heuristics simple and explainable.
sid: heuristic sketch: if variant_id != baseline -> model_swap. if median tokens shift > 20% -> token_shift. if prompt overlap < 60% -> prompt_change. confidence derived from sample_size and shift magnitude. mark approx=true if sample < 200.
kyle: agree about approx flag. UI should surface "approximate" badge and show sample size.
ingsest-bot: snapshot event recorded rollout=canary-2026-04-01T09:12Z by @reena
reena: signing/immutability: snapshots must be signed and stored as immutable blobs for audit customers. retention default 90d, extendable.
sid: aggregator SQL example (producer-side aggregation) to create compact rows:
```
SELECT route, variant, count(*) AS invocations,
       sum(tokens) AS tokens_billed,
       sum(cache_saved_tokens) AS cache_saved_tokens,
       sum(tokens * unit_price_cents) AS token_cost_cents
FROM invocation_telemetry
WHERE rollout_id = :rollout_id AND snapshot_bucket = :snapshot_ts
GROUP BY route, variant;
```
will post POST contract + example payloads tomorrow.
morgan: ok assigned: sid -> proto + endpoint, kyle -> UI mock + CSV, reena -> update runbook + retention ask.
reena: thanks, keeping thread as decision log. :thumbsup:
